# spokes-api/types/v1/diff_algorithm.proto



## Types

<a name="github.spokes.types.v1.DiffAlgorithm"></a>

### DiffAlgorithm
Algorithm encapsulates the possible algorithms for diffs.

| Name | Number | Description |
| ---- | ------ | ----------- |
| DIFF_ALGORITHM_INVALID | 0 | DIFF_STATUS_INVALID indicates an invalid diff algorithm. |
| DIFF_ALGORITHM_DEFAULT | 1 | DIFF_STATUS_DEFAULT indicates that the default algorithm is to be used. |
